title: NSA certificate for EA280 electronics intelligence course

tellings.quote: this certificate granted to Sherman by the NSA for satisfactory completion of the EA280 intermediate electronics intelligence collection and analysis course.

plain: Michels shows a certificate the NSA gave to Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, for "satisfactory completion of the EA280 intermediate electronics intelligence collection and analysis course" in the early 1990s. Michels offers it as support for Sherman's account. The certificate shows that Sherman took the NSA course, and it does not speak to what he says he was later asked to do.
